800x600 unconfigured: the same control is disabled, dashed and reads 'Sign-in unavailable'; hover title names the two env vars the daemon needs
1440x800 configured: the wide-width control is the same labelled pill, still inside the viewport and still without row overflow

at 800, 820, 1024, 1280, 1366, 1440 and 1920 the four priority controls the e2e lane asserts (BeatSyncMax, AutoPlay, Jobs drawer, master volume slider) all pass an elementFromPoint hit test at their own centre
viewport: 800x600 for the decisive frames, 1440x800 for the wide-width frame (also swept 820, 1024, 1280, 1366, 1920)
capture_tool: playwright 1.61.1 headless chromium (--no-sandbox --disable-dev-shm-usage --disable-gpu), element.screenshot for the top bar crop
limitations: the label is asserted as rendered text and as the accessible name at these widths; no screenshot of a real Google consent round trip is included, because that needs a real OAuth client that no hermetic lane has

the sweep numbers quoted in the commit message (160 of 229 widths overflowing before, 0 of 229 after) come from the same harness swept at 5px granularity; only the seven widths above are archived as images
the daemon is the production SPA server on this worktree's build, not the packaged desktop shell
